name: agent-mcp-solo
description: Tier-P F1 solo scenario: install ONLY agent-mcp and assert its standalone MCP-wrapper contract -- no agent-bridge sibling plugin, no resolver, no resident daemon required. A fresh machine must install the payload, self-provision the local runtime/binstub, report a real version, validate a simple bridge config, and fail a missing bridge name with a clear non-traceback error. Name-free / public.

stages.title: binstub on PATH + reports a REAL version
